findings.title: Swapped lightness percentages in .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a
findings.body: In `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a`, `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The `30%` and `70%` lightness values are reversed, which makes the author link much fainter in light themes (`70%` instead of `30%`) and too dark in dark themes (`30%` instead of `70%`). It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Swapped lightness percentages in .custom-message-length
findings.body: In `.custom-message-length`, `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The `70%` and `30%` values are inverted (compare `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/modal.scss` line 94), darkening the text in light themes and making it overly bright in dark themes. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Wrong lightness percentages in .topic-map h3 on mobile
findings.body: In `.topic-map h3`, `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))` (as in `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss` line 321). This changes the light-theme color and removes the contrast difference between `h3` and `h4` in the mobile topic map.

findings.title: Wrong lightness percentages in .group-member-info .name on desktop
findings.body: In `.user-stream .group-member-info .name`, `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was changed to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. This alters the existing light-theme color from `30%` to `50%` and uses `50%` instead of `70%` in dark themes.

findings.title: Wrong lightness percentages in .group-member-info .name on mobile
findings.body: In `.user-stream .group-member-info .name`, `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was changed to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` instead of `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. This alters the existing light-theme color from `30%` to `50%` and uses `50%` instead of `70%` in dark themes.

findings.title: Missed scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) in .topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification
findings.body: In `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification`, `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%);` was not wrapped in `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` (unlike the matching `.category .badge-notification` rule in `app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/header.scss` line 301).
